Frontline capacity released if redeployed (non-cash potential)
How to read this (at default assumptions)

1. The case's headline (Rp 221.7B value, 877% ROI, 1.4-month payback) adds up arithmetically, but it counts revenue lift and contact savings that cannot both happen, treats non-cash RM time as cash, and shows revenue as profit.
2. After correction, Year 1 is roughly break-even to negative (Base: net Rp -9.1B) because loans earn for only part of the year and credit cost and missing project costs are now included.
3. Over three years the Base case is clearly positive (cumulative net about Rp +131B, payback about 14 months). Conservative pays back in about 25 months; Upside inside Year 1.

4. Recommended message for the capstone: positive but not extraordinary, payback roughly 1-2 years, labelled a simulation. Sensitivity (lift realization, cost of risk, utilization) matters more than the headline.
5. Yellow cells on Assumptions are my placeholders. Replace them with sourced values from Bank reports, RM interviews and Finance before presenting (PRD F17).
